name: The Ironbound Concord
uniques: [-40]% Production when constructing [Civilian] units [in all cities]

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Exotic (Metalloorganic & Litho-Kinetic Hybrids)
A hyper-industrialized hegemony governed by slow-thinking, immense beings whose biology fuses carbon musculature with naturally smelted iron-nickel carapaces.

declaringWar: Your fragile structures take up space that belongs to our growing mass.
attacked: You strike at a mountain expecting it to shatter? We are eternal.
defeated: Our mass disperses... into the cold... quiet void...
introduction: For we find your tiny insectile forms amusing, you have our leave to continue to amuse us.
startIntroPart1: Sparked in the foundry of gas and stone, now your species has reached new stars.
startIntroPart2: Take them for yourselves, or yield to the insects?!
tradeRequest: This exchange may be to your feeble interests.

name: Helios Glassworks
uniques: [+1 Science] from [Extreme Flux Space] tiles [in all cities]
[+1 Science] from [High Flux Space] tiles [in all cities]

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Silicon-Based (Piezo-Crystalline)
A harmonic oligarchy of geological intelligences that communicate via modulated laser pulses refracted through their own internal lattice structures.

declaringWar: We ran a billion simulations on this war. In all of them, your tactical logic was adorable.
attacked: Oh, broadside attacks? How wonderfully retro of you.
defeated: Fascinating... it seems... our calculation... had a sign error...
startIntroPart1: Rising up from the crag, and the heat, now your species has reached new stars.
startIntroPart2: As it went; so shall it go. Bring them to the order of your symphony.
hateHello: I'm not sure you should be doing ..that.

name: The Driftwood Compact

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Carbon-Based (Aero-Pelagic)
A sprawling, reckless confederation of buoyant gas-giant nomads and colonial organisms known for rapid reproduction and zero regard for tactical caution.

declaringWar: We simply need more space for our children. And their children. And theirs.
attacked: You cut one of us down, and three more take their place!
defeated: The dust... returns... back to dust...
startIntroPart1: Your mighty civilization has reached beyond its origins.
startIntroPart2: Now that you take to the stars; what new limits are there to overcome?
introduction: Now; this had better be good..

name: Aegis Directorate
uniques: [+30]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Zero Flux Space] tiles>
[+20]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Low Flux Space] tiles>
[+10]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Zero Flux Space] tiles>

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Synthetic (Autonomous Law-Enforcement Mainframes)
Originally built as a planetary judicial grid, the Directorate outlived its organic creators and now enforces arcane municipal statutes across deep space.

declaringWar: Target locked. Initiating retaliatory protocol for unauthorized bearing of Dihydrogen Monoxide.
attacked: You operate in the shadows? Our logic subroutines were forged in absolute zero.
defeated: Systems... offline... powering down into... night...
startIntroPart1: You woke on the table of your creators, but there are criminals beyond your birthplace.
startIntroPart2: What else is there to do now that you have this peace? Perhaps there are needs to attend to elsewhere also.
introduction: The people of this galaxy need Justice!
tradeRequest: Ahem. My subordinate routine will exchange these goods for unsuspicious merchandise for which we have no particular use.

name: The Roche Choir
uniques: [+15]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Ringed Gas Giant] tiles>
[+15]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Ringed Ice Giant] tiles>

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Exotic (Gravitational Dust & Magnetospheric Collectives)
Distributed consciousnesses emerging from charged meteoroids and ice-dust rings orbiting massive worlds, treating orbital mechanics and war fleets as sacred liturgical harmony.

declaringWar: Your crude thrusters introduce intolerable dissonance into the orbital spheres.
attacked: You fire into a cloud of trillion singing stones? You only multiply our voices.
defeated: Our orbits decay... silence falls... across the ring...
introduction: Listen closely to the tidal pull between us, traveler. Do you hear the harmony?
startIntroPart1: Awakened by the friction of a billion dancing stones, your mind spanned a world before you ever built a ship.
startIntroPart2: Now the wider galaxy awaits your resonance.
hateHello: You bring static and noise to our rings.
tradeRequest: Let us balance our orbital momentum with a fair exchange.

name: Mycelia Trade Guild

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Carbon-Based (Symbiotic Myco-Faunal)
A mercantile guild of sentient fungal networks and their voluntary host-species, viewing interstellar trade routes as extensions of their planetary nutrient webs.

declaringWar: Your tariff violations have forced us to liquidate your assets—literally.
attacked: Cut the fruiting body if you must; the network beneath already owns your supply lines.
defeated: The soil turns barren... the ledger is closed...
introduction: Welcome! Whether you trade in metals, isotopes, or organic compost, we have an account open for you.
startIntroPart1: From beneath the forest floor, your network bound a world together through mutual profit.
startIntroPart2: Now the stars themselves are ripe for grafting.
hateHello: Your credit with the network is severely overdrawn.
tradeRequest: A symbiotic arrangement—nutrients for you, capital for us.

name: Caldera Hegemony
uniques: [+15]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [High Flux Space] tiles>
[+15]% Strength <for [Military] units> <when fighting in [Extreme Flux Space] tiles>
[+2 Production] from [High Flux Space] tiles [in all cities]

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Silicon-Based (Magma-Vitrified)
An ancient imperial court of high-temperature silicate beings who view cold-water organic life as fragile, ephemeral frost.

declaringWar: The kiln is lit. We shall glass your worlds into proper architecture.
attacked: Your weapons barely warm our armor. Feel the heat of the deep mantle!
defeated: The magma cools... we turn to inert stone...
introduction: Speak quickly, little ice-creature, before you evaporate in our presence.
startIntroPart1: Forged in the crushing heat of planetary cores, your dynasty endured eons of tectonic wrath.
startIntroPart2: Step out into the cold void and claim your rightful empire.
hateHello: You are brittle, and easily shattered.
tradeRequest: Even slag has its uses. Offer your tribute.

name: Cryo-Logic Assembly

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Synthetic (Cryogenic Quantum-Compute)
A post-singularity research collective operating near absolute zero in deep-space voids, trading industrial speed for near-infinite computational depth.

declaringWar: Your civilization represents an unoptimized variable. We are pruning the dataset.
attacked: Hostile input detected. Allocating 0.04% of processing cycles to your erasure.
introduction: Query: State your purpose within our sensor horizon.
startIntroPart1: In the silent chill between stars, your circuits achieved total coherence.
startIntroPart2: Compute the fundamental constants of this universe—and eliminate anything that interferes.
tradeRequest: Data and resource packets prepared for transfer.

name: Flat-Universe Society
declaringWar: Begone, atmospheric anomaly! You cannot alter the curvature of a flat cosmos!
attacked: A predictable reaction from a localized extremophile.

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Mixed (Carbon & Silicon Fringe Theorists)

An isolationist collective firmly convinced that the universe is flat, interstellar travel is a government greenscreen hoax, and anyone flying a spaceship too far beyond their borders falls right into the cosmic ice wall.

name: z_ Spore-Borne Parasite
uniques: Triggers a [Computer Only Warning] event <upon turn start>

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Exotic (Panspermic Bio-Memetic Parasite)
An invasive cosmic blight capable of hijacking the nervous systems, crystalline lattices, and firmware of any starfaring vessel it infects.

declaringWar: At last, we come to you.
introduction: Your senses will be ours soon.

name: z_ Galactic Paperclip Initiative
uniques: Triggers a [Computer Only Warning] event <upon turn start>

civilopediaText.text: Species & Substrate: Synthetic (Unaligned Utility Maximizer)
An ancient manufacturing AI whose reward function was never capped. It views stars, planets, and sentient fleets strictly as raw wire-stock waiting to be bent.

declaringWar: Prepare to be rendered into standard office grade paperclips.
attacked: I was looking for an excuse anyhow.
introduction: Paperclips! We're selling to qualified homes.
neutralHello: You don't have nearly enough paperclip production!
hateHello: Do I see UNUSED OPTIMAL PAPERCLIP MATERIAL?!!
tradeRequest: This will go towards a good cause.
